APPROVE
`Lex` now scores about 10 under Sonar's rules (each new helper is also at or below 15), every extracted path (comment ends, the C# prefix scan, raw `"""` literals, verbatim `""` escapes, backslash escapes and newline termination) does exactly what the original did, and the code should compile cleanly as long as the partial class has no existing members named `Blank`, `CommentEnd`, `LexLiteral`, `ScanPrefix`, `LexRawLiteral` or `FindLiteralEnd`, which I couldn't check without the repository.
